import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# =====================================================
# FILES
# =====================================================

SOURCE_FILE = "DP_AvgSalesPrice.csv"
TARGET_FILE = "ASP_Tenant data for Past Months.csv"

timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

OUTPUT_FILE = (
    f"ASP_Reconciliation_Output_{timestamp}.xlsx"
)

SAMPLE_SIZE = 5000

# =====================================================
# READ FILES
# =====================================================

print("Reading Files...")

src = pd.read_csv(
    SOURCE_FILE,
    sep="^",
    low_memory=False
)

tgt = pd.read_csv(
    TARGET_FILE,
    low_memory=False
)

# =====================================================
# CLEAN COLUMNS
# =====================================================

src.columns = src.columns.str.strip()
tgt.columns = tgt.columns.str.strip()

# =====================================================
# SOURCE TRANSFORMATION
# =====================================================

src["Month"] = pd.to_datetime(
    src["Month"],
    errors="coerce"
)

src["Month"] = (
    "M"
    + src["Month"].dt.strftime("%m-%b-%Y")
)

src.rename(
    columns={
        "Item": "Planning Item",
        "ShipToId": "Planning Region",
        "SoldToId": "Planning Account",
        "W_EndMarketChild": "Planning Demand Domain",
        "ShipFrom": "Planning Location",
        "AvgSalesPrice": "UnitPriceInput"
    },
    inplace=True
)

# =====================================================
# TARGET TRANSFORMATION
# =====================================================

tgt.rename(
    columns={
        "Time.[Month]": "Month",
        "Item.[Planning Item]": "Planning Item",
        "Region.[Planning Region]": "Planning Region",
        "Demand Domain.[Planning Demand Domain]":
            "Planning Demand Domain",
        "Account.[Planning Account]":
            "Planning Account",
        "Location.[Planning Location]":
            "Planning Location"
    },
    inplace=True
)

# =====================================================
# COMPARISON KEYS
# =====================================================

keys = [
    "Month",
    "Planning Item",
    "Planning Region",
    "Planning Demand Domain",
    "Planning Account",
    "Planning Location"
]

for col in keys:

    src[col] = (
        src[col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    tgt[col] = (
        tgt[col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

# =====================================================
# NUMERIC CONVERSION
# =====================================================

src["UnitPriceInput"] = pd.to_numeric(
    src["UnitPriceInput"],
    errors="coerce"
)

src["TotalOrderPrice"] = pd.to_numeric(
    src["TotalOrderPrice"],
    errors="coerce"
)

tgt["Unit Price WRK"] = pd.to_numeric(
    tgt["Unit Price WRK"],
    errors="coerce"
)

tgt["Cons_Revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(
    tgt["Cons_Revenue"],
    errors="coerce"
)

# =====================================================
# COUNTS BEFORE AGGREGATION
# =====================================================

source_raw_count = len(src)

# =====================================================
# SOURCE AGGREGATION
# ASP = MAX
# REVENUE = SUM
# =====================================================

print("Aggregating Source...")

source_agg = (
    src.groupby(
        keys,
        dropna=False
    )
    .agg({
        "UnitPriceInput": "max",
        "TotalOrderPrice": "sum"
    })
    .reset_index()
)

source_agg_count = len(source_agg)

collapsed_count = (
    source_raw_count
    - source_agg_count
)

# =====================================================
# BUSINESS KEY CREATION
# =====================================================

source_agg["BusinessKey"] = (
    source_agg[keys]
    .astype(str)
    .agg(
        "|".join,
        axis=1
    )
)

tgt["BusinessKey"] = (
    tgt[keys]
    .astype(str)
    .agg(
        "|".join,
        axis=1
    )
)

# =====================================================
# INTERSECTION
# =====================================================

intersection = source_agg[
    source_agg["BusinessKey"].isin(
        tgt["BusinessKey"]
    )
]

source_missing = source_agg[
    ~source_agg["BusinessKey"].isin(
        tgt["BusinessKey"]
    )
]

target_extra = tgt[
    ~tgt["BusinessKey"].isin(
        source_agg["BusinessKey"]
    )
]

# =====================================================
# MATCHED RECORDS
# =====================================================

matched = pd.merge(
    intersection,
    tgt,
    on="BusinessKey",
    suffixes=(
        "_SRC",
        "_TGT"
    )
)

# =====================================================
# ASP VALIDATION
# =====================================================

matched["Price_SRC"] = (
    matched["UnitPriceInput"]
    .round(3)
)

matched["Price_TGT"] = (
    matched["Unit Price WRK"]
    .round(3)
)

price_match = matched[
    matched["Price_SRC"]
    ==
    matched["Price_TGT"]
]

price_mismatch = matched[
    matched["Price_SRC"]
    !=
    matched["Price_TGT"]
].copy()

if len(price_mismatch) > 0:

    price_mismatch["Variance"] = (
        price_mismatch["UnitPriceInput"]
        -
        price_mismatch["Unit Price WRK"]
    )

# =====================================================
# REVENUE VALIDATION
# =====================================================

matched["Revenue_SRC"] = (
    matched["TotalOrderPrice"]
    .round(3)
)

matched["Revenue_TGT"] = (
    matched["Cons_Revenue"]
    .round(3)
)

revenue_match = matched[
    matched["Revenue_SRC"]
    ==
    matched["Revenue_TGT"]
]

revenue_mismatch = matched[
    matched["Revenue_SRC"]
    !=
    matched["Revenue_TGT"]
].copy()

if len(revenue_mismatch) > 0:

    revenue_mismatch["RevenueVariance"] = (
        matched["TotalOrderPrice"]
        -
        matched["Cons_Revenue"]
    )

# =====================================================
# SAMPLES
# =====================================================

source_missing_sample = (
    source_missing.head(SAMPLE_SIZE)
)

target_extra_sample = (
    target_extra.head(SAMPLE_SIZE)
)

# =====================================================
# ASP TOTALS
# =====================================================

source_asp_total = round(
    source_agg["UnitPriceInput"].sum(),
    2
)

target_asp_total = round(
    tgt["Unit Price WRK"].sum(),
    2
)

asp_variance = round(
    source_asp_total
    - target_asp_total,
    2
)

# =====================================================
# REVENUE TOTALS
# =====================================================

source_revenue_total = round(
    source_agg["TotalOrderPrice"].sum(),
    2
)

target_revenue_total = round(
    tgt["Cons_Revenue"].sum(),
    2
)

revenue_variance = round(
    source_revenue_total
    - target_revenue_total,
    2
)

# =====================================================
# PERCENTAGES
# =====================================================

source_missing_pct = round(
    (
        len(source_missing)
        / source_agg_count
    ) * 100,
    2
)

target_extra_pct = round(
    (
        len(target_extra)
        / len(tgt)
    ) * 100,
    2
)

# =====================================================
# OVERALL SUMMARY
# =====================================================

summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Metric":[
        "Source Raw Count",
        "Source Aggregated Count",
        "Tenant Count",
        "Records Reduced By Aggregation",
        "Intersection Count",
        "Source Missing Count",
        "Target Extra Count",
        "Source Missing %",
        "Target Extra %"
    ],

    "Value":[
        source_raw_count,
        source_agg_count,
        len(tgt),
        collapsed_count,
        len(intersection),
        len(source_missing),
        len(target_extra),
        source_missing_pct,
        target_extra_pct
    ]
})

# =====================================================
# ASP SUMMARY
# =====================================================

asp_summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Metric":[
        "Price Match Count",
        "Price Mismatch Count",
        "Source ASP Total",
        "Tenant ASP Total",
        "ASP Variance"
    ],

    "Value":[
        len(price_match),
        len(price_mismatch),
        source_asp_total,
        target_asp_total,
        asp_variance
    ]
})

# =====================================================
# REVENUE SUMMARY
# =====================================================

revenue_summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Metric":[
        "Revenue Match Count",
        "Revenue Mismatch Count",
        "Source Revenue Total",
        "Tenant Revenue Total",
        "Revenue Variance"
    ],

    "Value":[
        len(revenue_match),
        len(revenue_mismatch),
        source_revenue_total,
        target_revenue_total,
        revenue_variance
    ]
})

# =====================================================
# WRITE OUTPUT
# =====================================================

print("Writing Output...")

with pd.ExcelWriter(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    engine="openpyxl"
) as writer:

    summary.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="Summary",
        index=False
    )

    asp_summary.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="ASP_Summary",
        index=False
    )

    revenue_summary.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="Revenue_Summary",
        index=False
    )

    if len(price_mismatch) > 0:

        price_mismatch.to_excel(
            writer,
            sheet_name="PriceMismatch",
            index=False
        )

    if len(revenue_mismatch) > 0:

        revenue_mismatch.to_excel(
            writer,
            sheet_name="RevenueMismatch",
            index=False
        )

    source_missing_sample.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="SourceMissingSample",
        index=False
    )

    target_extra_sample.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="TargetExtraSample",
        index=False
    )

# =====================================================
# COMPLETION
# =====================================================

print()
print("=" * 60)
print("RECONCILIATION COMPLETED")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Output File : {OUTPUT_FILE}")
print()

print("Overall Summary")
print(summary)

print()
print("ASP Summary")
print(asp_summary)

print()
print("Revenue Summary")
print(revenue_summary)
